_comment: MODEL L (Assamese) reasoning finetune, run 3: worked answers. Consumed by common/finetune.py via FinetuneConfig.from_json. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation.
_init: Starts from Model L's own Phase 2 best.pt (step 9,110, validation
loss 3.9043). finetune.py refuses a checkpoint whose model_config
names a different language. The path is the local staging directory
from common/workspace.py; pass --init to point elsewhere.
name: model_l_reasoning_gentle
_run4: Run 4. Run 3 solved the numeric tasks on seen names (0.955-0.998) but
at the cost of the language model itself: on the Phase 2 test split,
test perplexity went from 13.79 to 6,709 for Model H and from 61.94 to
868,303 for Model L. 8,000 steps at 3e-4 on templated text is enough to
overwrite what pretraining built, which makes the finetuned checkpoint
useless as a language model and the attention comparison a measure of
Two variants are run and compared on BOTH axes -- reasoning accuracy and
test perplexity -- and the one that keeps the language is kept:
gentle  the full 120,000 examples, 1,500 steps at peak 5e-5
